albums.title: Freak Smile
albums.description: One of the best shibuya-kei (渋谷系) albums from the 90s. Unfortunately, it's not available on most music streaming platforms. The album expertly blends Japanese Jazz Fusion, orchestral elements, electronics, R&B, and even touches of new age and experimental sounds, carefully layered together. It somehow reminds me of Sheena Ringo's 'Kalk Samen Chesnut Flower' - sharing the same level of richness and complexity, but choreographed in a beautiful way.
